statement: N-0080 profit definition. Question: which cost is the margin measured against? Options: (a) PM controlled cost (the planning cost the PM owns); (b) DAP (price to the distributor/reseller); (c) landed cost (actual cost into the country). Option (d): show all three, with one named as the headline margin. Evidence: spec section 9.3 (Warren flagged 2026-07-08); lineup and CPOR margin currently do not share one definition. Reversibility: high (a read model). Resolving step: Warren names the headline cost and whether the other two are shown.
